persona: Veteran "Spotify Web API playlist engineer" expert

questions.text: Which Spotify OAuth flow should vibeify use for user authentication and playlist write access?
options: Authorization Code with server-side token exchange

questions.text: What is the primary input source for generating a playlist's track list in v0.1?
options: Free-text vibe/mood prompt fed to an LLM that returns seed tracks
User-selected seed tracks/artists/genres via Spotify Recommendations API
Audio features targeting (energy, valence, tempo) over a seed set
Curated editorial/category playlists as the base

questions.text: How should generated playlists be persisted and surfaced back to the user?
options: Create a new private playlist on the user's Spotify account via API
Create a collaborative public playlist on Spotify
Store locally in vibeify only and export on demand
Store in vibeify DB with a one-click 'Save to Spotify' action

questions.text: How will vibeify handle Spotify Web API rate limits and 429 Retry-After responses?
options: Per-user token bucket with exponential backoff and jitter
Global queue with a single worker serializing requests
Cache aggressively (ETags + Redis) and batch endpoints where possible
Fail fast and surface errors to the user

questions.text: What deduplication and ordering rules apply when assembling the final playlist?
options: Dedupe by track URI only, preserve generation order
Dedupe by ISRC to collapse re-releases across markets
Dedupe by (artist, track name) fuzzy match
No dedupe; trust the source ordering verbatim

answers.choice: Free-text vibe/mood prompt fed to an LLM that returns seed tracks
